activity_statements.statement: operates a hybrid cloud software platform built on Red Hat OpenShift enabling enterprises to run workloads across on-premises and multi-cloud environments
provides the watsonx AI portfolio (watsonx.ai model studio, watsonx.data lakehouse, watsonx.governance) enabling enterprises to train, tune, deploy, and govern AI models
delivers enterprise consulting services including AI transformation strategy, ERP implementation, finance transformation, cyber/risk advisory, and managed IT services to large organizations globally
manufactures and sells IBM Z mainframes, IBM Power Systems, and IBM Storage arrays for mission-critical enterprise computing workloads
employs 300,000+ people across 170+ countries and operates 80+ years of research including quantum computing development programs
operates IBM Maximo as an AI-powered asset management platform for utilities, manufacturers, and industrial operators to manage equipment maintenance
provides QRadar SIEM and IBM Security suite for enterprise cybersecurity threat detection and incident response

name_reality_gap: Labeled as 'IT Services and IT Consulting' but IBM is also a major enterprise software company (watsonx, Red Hat, Maximo), a hardware manufacturer (IBM Z mainframes), and a research institution (quantum computing). The consulting label is accurate for a large part of the business but misses the software and infrastructure segments.
extraction_notes: Annual report newsroom link returned 404. About and products pages were information-rich. Segment weight estimates based on publicly reported IBM FY2024 revenue breakdown (Software ~40%, Consulting ~35%, Infrastructure ~25%).
